straight N-S north of W 5th; south of W 5th it runs SSW (dx/dy -0.20) and widens to 50'

notes: Stone (50') is one straight diagonal (east building line x = 1665 - 0.314*(y-368), west = sheet-20 block outlines) from W 6th (T) to W 3rd (T). Carlisle jogs at Stone: the part east of Stone (printed CARLISLE AV.) has centre y~1087 at Stone, the part west of Stone (outlined, sheet 20) y~1158; both recorded as T's. Cutter is printed CUTTER (PARK) and the frontages are labelled PARK; north of W 6th nothing is drawn (key map suggests a street continues north between sheets 40 and 41, offset), so recorded as T. Mill starts at W 5th (T). Sweeney (printed SWEENEY; = Sweeney (Avery Alley) on sheet 20) runs ESE right across the sheet: Stone, the Alley, Mill, Cutter, and continues east of Cutter between outlined sheet-22 blocks. The N-S alley between Sweeney and W 4th is printed only ALLEY (18'); it lines up with Carl (printed CARL) south of W 4th, so that crossing is one cross (Carl / W 4th). Webb Alley (20') narrows to 10' east of Carl (north building line continuous) and ends at Mill. Barnet Alley (10') runs ESE from Mill and stops at an open passage that leads south to Sweeney. W 3rd centre taken from the south (sheet 8) block line minus 25 ft; its north side is C&O freight-house/railroad land. Mill/W 3rd is ~65 px above the bottom paper edge. Barr Alley continues east across Cutter on sheet 22 (BARREL (BARR) ALLEY) although the sheet-22 outline here does not show the gap, so Cutter/Barr is recorded as a cross.
